_provenance.how: Built by instantiating the SDK's own pydantic models (google.genai._gaos.types.interactions.Interaction and the Step union members) and serialising with model_dump(mode='json'). Pydantic validated every required field, Literal discriminator and open-union member at construction, so the shape is the vendor's, not the author's.
_provenance.no_model_calls: No Gemini model was called and no API key is needed. Only the type layer ran, so this fixture adds no vendor dependency to the tests.
_provenance.field_values_are_authored: The SHAPE is the vendor's; the VALUES (ids, text, timings, token counts) are authored to make a coherent scenario, exactly as the openai_*.json fixtures do.
_provenance.shape_guarantee_limits: google-genai's _gaos BaseModel sets extra='allow', and Step is an OPEN union parsed leniently, so unknown keys are not rejected on the read path. The guarantee covers required fields, Literal discriminators and union membership at CONSTRUCTION time; capture_gemini.py --check adds a strict per-class re-validation because Interaction.model_validate alone would not raise.
_provenance.scenario: Order-4417 late-shipment refund that succeeds. Steps run user_input -> thought -> function_call(lookup_order) -> function_result(is_error=False, object result) -> model_output; usage is fully populated including per-modality breakdowns, and the interaction ends `completed`.
